name: Credit
description:
You have a line of credit with the Banking Houses.

You may attempt to purchase any equipment item on credit. Roll Persuade against the Difficulty (0 by default). On a pass, you gain the item for free, and increase the Difficulty by the item's cost, in Treasure.

When you have excessive debts, you feel uneasy:

  • When determining Compagnia at the start of a Quest, subtract ⅕ of the current Difficulty from the total Compagnia.

  • Whenever you finish a long rest, check a number of Conditions equal to ⅒ of the current Difficulty.

You may repay your debts at any time, paying Treasure, 1-for-1, to reduce the Difficulty.

Describe how you bear the weight of your debts.
successes:
✨: The vendor has favorable terms with the Banking Houses. This purchase adds 1 less to the Difficulty.

🌞: The vendor has extremely favorable terms with the Banking Houses. This purchase adds 3 less to the Difficulty.

💀: The vendor is authorized to collect debts on behalf of the Banking Houses. If the Difficulty is less than 10, you may not make further purchases on credit with any vendor in your current location. If the Difficulty is 10 or more, you must repay your debts immediately or face imprisonment for a number of weeks equal to the Difficulty, after which your debts are cleared and the Difficulty resets to 0. Either way, you gain 1 Shadow.
